verdict.rationale: Klaviyo explicitly documents a sandbox/test account workflow — 'Test custom integrations and apps without the risk of impacting your production account' and 'Populate your test account with sample data' — directly matching the story's ask. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of sandbox fidelity, details on how AI agents specifically would target the sandbox vs production (e.g., MCP server sandbox mode), and any limitations on sandbox data parity.
